svg.title: Figure 6-5: freedom on the Internet
svg.desc: Of 65 countries assessed, 15 are free, including the United States, Canada, Australia, Argentina, and Japan; 29 are partly free, including Mexico, Brazil, India, and Indonesia; 21 are not free, including Russia and China. Two-thirds of Internet users live where criticism of the government, military, or ruling family is censored.

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
